q: 我的桌子比你的___大。
en: My desk is bigger than yours.

q: 今天经理比昨天___忙，连午饭都没吃。
en: The manager is even busier today than yesterday; he didn't even have lunch.

q: 这家医院比那家___远。
en: This hospital is farther away than that one.

q: 这个月的工作比上个月___多，大家每天都要加班。
en: This month's workload is bigger than last month's, so everyone has to work overtime every day.

q: 这个药比那个药贵___。
en: This medicine is a bit more expensive than that one.

q: 坐地铁去公司比开车快___，不用堵车。
en: Taking the subway to the office is much faster than driving; there's no traffic jam.

q: 他今天的咳嗽比昨天好___。
en: His cough is much better today than yesterday.

q: 我的血压比去年低___，医生说不用吃药了。
en: My blood pressure is a little lower than last year; the doctor says I no longer need medicine.

q: 新来的同事比我___三岁，可是工作经验比我多。
en: The new colleague is three years younger than me, but he has more work experience.

q: 这家公司的工资比我们公司高___，所以不少人想去那儿工作。
en: This company's pay is much higher than ours, so quite a few people want to work there.

q: 病人今天没有昨天___难受。
en: The patient isn't as uncomfortable today as yesterday.

q: 我的工作没有你的___累。
en: My job isn't as tiring as yours.

q: 这个办公室___那个办公室大，只有那个的一半，我们得搬走。
en: This office is not as big as that one, only half the size, so we have to move.

q: 坐公共汽车去医院没有坐地铁___，所以我每次都坐地铁。
en: Taking the bus to the hospital isn't as fast as taking the subway, so I always take the subway.

q: 你说他比我高？他___我高，我们一样高。
en: You say he's taller than me? He's no taller than me; we're the same height.

q: 我的英语___小王，他在美国住过五年。
en: My English is not as good as Xiao Wang's; he lived in America for five years.

q: 坐班车___自己开车方便，所以他还是每天开车上班。
en: Taking the shuttle bus is not as convenient as driving yourself, so he still drives to work every day.

q: 我的手机___你的一样。
en: My phone is the same as yours.

q: 小王和我___高。
en: Xiao Wang and I are equally tall.

q: 我们公司的上班时间跟他们公司___，他们九点，我们八点半。
en: Our working hours are different from theirs: they start at nine, we start at half past eight.

q: 今天医院的病人跟昨天一样___，一直排到门口。
en: There are just as many patients at the hospital today as yesterday; the line reaches the door.

q: 我们办公室七个人里，小李___忙。
en: Of the seven people in our office, Xiao Li is the busiest.

q: 这个药很苦，那个药___苦。
en: This medicine is bitter and that one is even more bitter.

q: 这家公司的工资___高，不过不是最高的，工作也很累。
en: The pay at this company is fairly high, though not the highest, and the work is tiring.

q: 在我们公司，经理___早到，每个人都比他晚。
en: In our company the manager arrives earliest; everyone is later than him.

q: 这件事是我们办公室里___重要的。
en: This is the most important matter in our office.

q: 小王比我打字打___快。
en: Xiao Wang types faster than me.

q: 他今天起___比我早，七点就到公司了。
en: He got up earlier than me today; he was at the company by seven.

q: 他说汉语说得___我好。
en: He speaks Chinese better than I do.

q: 弟弟睡___比我多，每天睡十个小时。
en: My younger brother sleeps more than I do, ten hours a day.

q: 奶奶的身体___好了，每天都能散步。
en: Grandma's health is getting better and better; she can take a walk every day.

q: 他每天跑步，跑得___快了。
en: He runs every day and runs faster and faster.

q: 天气越来越冷，医院里感冒的病人也___多了。
en: The weather is getting colder, and there are more and more patients with colds at the hospital.

q: 听说这个城市的空气___差，很多人都生病了。
en: I hear the air in this city is getting worse and worse and many people have fallen ill.

q: 他的汉语说得___好，同事们都夸他。
en: His Chinese is getting better and better, and his colleagues all praise him.
